The issuer shows materially weak balance sheet credit fundamentals: shareholders’ equity is deeply negative and total liabilities exceed total assets, indicating sustained capital impairment. Liquidity is only modest (current ratio ~1.09), and while operating performance appears positive (EBIT ~2.6B on ~23.1B revenue), the overall leverage and negative equity point to a high credit risk profile consistent with a lower speculative-grade rating.  

DECISION: B+
